title: 日本加息：救不了日元，关键在国债
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Is the September hike enough to see appreciation or do you need something bigger?
segments.zh: 九月加息是否足以推动日元升值，还是需要更大幅度的行动？

segments.en: You know, I would really like to say, oh, a September hike will be enough, but my gut feeling is they need more.
segments.zh: 我确实想说九月加息就够了，但直觉告诉我，他们需要更多。

segments.en: You know, there's an awful lot going on in Japan. A huge amount in terms of reforms, a huge amount, you know, to time at the stock market, better regulated, for instance,
segments.zh: 日本正在发生很多事情，改革力度很大，市场监管也在改善。

segments.en: the inflation, the fact that they have inflation. I mean, that's a pretty exciting in terms of investment, because clearly, you know, if you have disinflation deflation,
segments.zh: 通胀的出现本身就令人兴奋，因为如果长期通缩，资金会大量停留在现金上。

segments.en: you invest a lot in cash, and so there's huge parts of cash which could go into assets, you know, and it's making its way into assets. I think that's exciting for Japan.
segments.zh: 现在这些现金正逐步流入资产，这对日本来说是个积极信号。

segments.en: That's exciting, I think, for international investors looking for opportunities.
segments.zh: 对寻求机会的国际市场参与者来说，这很令人振奋。

segments.en: They have a lot of supply chains with respect to semiconductors, and that too makes the country quite exciting. But the market is focused on two things, and one of course is the interest rate
segments.zh: 日本在半导体供应链上也有优势，但市场关注两点：利率差异和日本国债供给。

segments.en: differential outlook, and the other is supply of JDBs. And of course, in if you like, we were really exposed to JDBs in 2024 when we saw the end of QQE, and I think that has sort of
segments.zh: 2024年量化宽松结束时，我们看到了日本国债供给问题，这暴露了巨额债务的担忧。

segments.en: unmasked this whole issue about the huge debt. And I think the market needs more reassurances on supply of JDBs, along with a faster pace of interest rate heights. And until we have really
segments.zh: 市场需要更多关于国债供给的保证，以及更快的加息步伐。

segments.en: strong confidence in that, I think the end's going to be a little bit more vulnerable.
segments.zh: 在获得强信心之前，日元可能仍将较为脆弱。

segments.en: So to be clear, so there's further weakness in store for the end, unless those two things come together, both the BOJ and on the government side addressing the fiscal concerns.
segments.zh: 所以，除非日本央行和政府同时解决财政问题，否则日元可能进一步走弱。
